newsitem.title: USA: Nashua may sell European film processing.
newsitem.headline: Nashua may sell European film processing.

text.p: Nashua Corp said Monday it is negotiating the sale of its $29 million mainland European film processing operations, which is a component of Nashua's Photofinishing Group, to Spector Photo Group N.V., a Belgium-based film processor.
Nashua acquired the mainland European film processing operations, as well as an operation in Northern Ireland, in January 1995 from Nexus Photo Limited.
Nashua said it intends to retain its Northern Ireland-based business.
Nashua said its mainland European film processing business includes mail-order photofinishing services in France, Belgium, the Netherlands and Spain.
